57 * 47 - 36 * 26 = 57 * 47 - 36 * (25 + 1)
= 57 * 47 - (36 * 25 + 36)
= 57 * 47 - (900 + 36)
= 57 * 47 - 936

We already know 57 * 47 is 2679, so:
2679 - 936 = 1743
